lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Hello again! Barnaby here. On my <color=red>stroll</color> this morning, I found a little book all about dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: It's full of <color=red>riddles</color>! Solve three of them and three new books will appear in the library.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Let me see... ah yes, I copied them onto the back of my hand. How <color=red>sensible</color> of me!

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 1: I was pressed into soft mud long ago, and now I have <color=red>hardened</color> into rock. I show exactly where a dinosaur once walked. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. What would a dinosaur leave behind when it walked through mud?
lines.correctText: Correct! A footprint shows where a dinosaur walked.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 2: I am a <color=red>scientist</color> who digs up dinosaur bones and studies them with brushes and tiny tools. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which person would dig up bones and study them?
lines.correctText: Yes! A palaeontologist studies dinosaur bones.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Riddle 3: My name means '<color=red>tyrant</color> lizard king'. I had huge, sharp teeth but surprisingly tiny arms. What am I?
lines.hint: Not quite. Which name sounds a bit like 'tyrant'?
lines.correctText: Exactly! Tyrannosaurus rex, the tyrant lizard king.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Three for three! You're a <color=red>remarkable</color> riddle-solver. Three new books are heading to the library right now.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thanks again for solving my riddles. I'd tell you another, but I seem to have <color=red>misplaced</color> it!
